description.html: This nano aquarium (25x19x20 cm, 9.5 L) is made from quality glass of the right thickness. Smaller aquariums need more careful maintenance of water parameters, but they are a great choice for a desk or shelf.
The compact dimensions allow creative decoration with small plants and pebbles. The recommended filter is a sponge filter with an air pump, which does not create too strong a current for small fish.

We make the aquarium by hand, so adjustments are possible: non-standard dimensions, openings for filter hoses, a reinforced bottom for heavier stone. Message us or call for an estimate. Courier delivery throughout Serbia.
